2 PM Eastern call with Olesya Orozco from Ivory Maison. Rebooked with a working Google Meet link, James is on the invite.

Terra Lotus, seventy-eight thousand five hundred eighty dollars, is our biggest deal — fifty-two percent of the monthly target. Aidan owns the volume pricing conversation. Nudged in the priority channel, awaiting his reply.

Atlas Eternal, twenty-six thousand five hundred dollars, deposit is PAID. The documents question is closed — the job moves to production now, with the thirteen thousand two hundred fifty dollar balance due on completion.
Wednesday call with Kenna is confirmed. That's the gate on Pure Good, roughly three hundred twenty-nine thousand dollars.
New inbound: Ashley Harmon from ApothikSKIN, a botanical skincare brand, came in through the website contact form.

kb.a: The website and forms lane is agent-owned and in progress. Contact forms are verified delivering to sam@prvtlabellabs.com, the SEO-agency form is disabled, and the address is migrated. The real gaps are that Book a Call has no scheduler wired and hCaptcha may be silently dropping leads. The agent is waiting on Sam's booking URL — he has one but it does not attach a Google Meet link — and is building hardened forms on a draft theme. Nothing publishes without Sam's approval.

OpenSend needs Sam's noon approval for three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate PLL Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking-calendar URL, and ICP Tier A. Domain and inbox warmup takes about two to three weeks, so any delay today delays pipeline creation.

The PLL CRM browser session is signed out at the login screen. Restoring pll_tasklet_consultant access is needed for CRM fix verification, Aidan's purchasing knowledge-base extraction, and UnShrink It verification. Today's carried CRM dashboard figures are not live verification.

Aidan's Command Lab is live and self-publishing its brief at 7 AM. It still needs Aidan to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so it can incorporate CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of relying on Outlook only.
Oreka / Nadia needs a yes or no on the $8,555 payment and the 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job. Approval releases the cash-and-production handoff; the decision is waiting on Sam.

Victor Armendarez has a 4,000-unit, two-SKU opportunity: Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel. The quote still needs confirmed packaging, fill, labor, and overhead costs; do not issue pricing until the cost basis is complete.
Tiffany requires a call before travel. The immediate commercial objective and exact timing are not verified in current sources, so confirm both on the call rather than inventing a commitment.

Yorel, founder of Hubs & Babydoll, is a multi-product manufacturing inquiry covering body oils, beard products, body butter, and body wash. Sales requested quantity, inventory budget, formula needs, brand assets, and WhatsApp availability before scheduling a consultation. No value is verified yet.

Hina at Heirloom is seeking frosted-style packaging for a 2,500-piece peptide cream run with silk-screened lids and secondary boxes. She is connected with Laura for container sourcing, and the Heirloom container meeting is set for Tuesday, Aug 11 at 10 AM ET. Bring current container options.

Alex at Shopokami wants wholesale per-unit pricing for the Whipped Body Butter with Beef Tallow at 50, 100, and 250 units. He asked Sam to call him directly at +1 514-242-7072 rather than meet by Google Meet. Sam explained per-unit pricing is not listed publicly because it moves with quantity, jar size, and label finish; this is a live conversation awaiting Sam's pricing follow-up.

The preserved Aug 10 safety refresh shows both verified net-new campaigns still on Maximize Conversions with zero tracked conversions. Trailing-7 spend is $157.80, or 89% of the live configured cap, so there is no cap breach. Sam can approve reverting both campaigns to Manual CPC; no Ads change has been made.
Sam's lane today is Terra Lotus first, Atlas Eternal second, then the noon OpenSend decision. Do not switch to facility, website, or lower-value work until the Terra package is sent.

Terra Lotus is a $78,580 opportunity, about 52% of the $150K monthly target. Aidan owns the volume-pricing conversation; the priority channel has been nudged and his reply is pending. Keep this lane with Aidan rather than reopening old contract-detail assumptions.

Hass Alamer has an 11 AM Eastern booked call today for a new 2,000-unit hair-care line: a leave-in conditioner and hair oil. Treat it as a conversion call and push qualified scope directly to a quote. No price or final specifications are confirmed yet.

Olesya Orozco from Ivory Maison has a 2 PM Eastern call today. It was rebooked with a working Google Meet link, and James is on the invite. Use the call to qualify needs and set the commercial next step.
Pure Good is a roughly $329K opportunity. The Wednesday call with Kenna is confirmed and is the gate to advance it. The exact blocker resolution remains to be confirmed on that call.

Ashley Harmon from ApothikSKIN is a new inbound website-contact-form lead. ApothikSKIN is described as a botanical skincare brand. Qualification details, product scope, quantity, and timing are still unknown.
Atlas Eternal is a $26,500 opportunity awaiting Sam review. Do not state that documents are ready to send until Sam’s review is complete. The next action after review is not verified in this refresh.
